body: Mac node model settings for Brian, read from h9k config show at 2026-09-25 14:45 EDT by hall9k-a7, nothing changed: default-model claude-opus-5-5[1m] (config); effort NOT SET (default, sessions run at the model's own default, so Opus 5.5 reviews at medium here); model (build) claude-sonnet-5 (config); model (fix) claude-sonnet-5 (config); model (review) claude-opus-5-5[1m] (config); model (review-finalpass) not set, follows review; model (review-verify) claude-sonnet-5 (config); model (synthesis) claude-sonnet-5 (config); model (publication) claude-sonnet-5 (config); model (refinement) not set, follows default-model; model (courier) not set, falls through to project default or Sonnet; orchestrator-model claude-fable-5-1[1m] (config file); auto-pr-review-mint-hold 300s (default, the Mac is the leader by id). Per-project overrides on the Mac: none of hall9k, odonomics, arx-platform, ntss-platform sets --model; every one shows orchestrator model claude-fable-5-1[1m] inherited from the node. So the two nodes match on every role; the only differences are effort (Windows high, Mac unset) and the mint hold (Windows 0, Mac 300 default).
